findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: complete, resume_packet, checkpoint_put, checkpoint_get, watermark_get, seen_add, seen_check, retry_state, send, budget_check, barrier_create, barrier_signal, should_continue · Private data: register, lease, lease_renew, resume_packet, checkpoint_put, watermark_set, seen_add, retry_state, send, inbox_ack, heartbeat, budget_record, work_take, work_done, work_status · Public sink: register, whoami, claim, complete, lease, lease_renew, lease_release, resume_packet, checkpoint_put, checkpoint_get, watermark_set, watermark_get, seen_add, seen_check, retry_state, send, inbox_schedule, inbox_poll, inbox_ack, inbox_nack, heartbeat, budget_record, budget_check, barrier_create, barrier_signal, barrier_status, work_push, work_take, work_done, work_fail, work_status, job_cancel, should_continue · Destructive: heartbeat, barrier_create, job_cancel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: complete, resume_packet, checkpoint_put, checkpoint_get, watermark_get, seen_add, seen_check, retry_state, send, budget_check, barrier_create, barrier_signal, should_continue · Private data: register, lease, lease_renew, resume_packet, checkpoint_put, watermark_set, seen_add, retry_state, send, inbox_ack, heartbeat, budget_record, work_take, work_done, work_status · Public sink: register, whoami, claim, complete, lease, lease_renew, lease_release, resume_packet, checkpoint_put, checkpoint_get, watermark_set, watermark_get, seen_add, seen_check, retry_state, send, inbox_schedule, inbox_poll, inbox_ack, inbox_nack, heartbeat, budget_record, budget_check, barrier_create, barrier_signal, barrier_status, work_push, work_take, work_done, work_fail, work_status, job_cancel, should_continue · Destructive: heartbeat, barrier_create, job_cancel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
